Name: Joja Clearance Bin
Author: CopperSun
Description:
Ugh, forgot to buy blueberry seeds during the summer? It's okay, you might still be able to get them on clearance at Joja! Shop the new Mystery Bin, which contains five random products each day. Members get a 10% discount!

Additional stock may be found if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8746]Joja Seeds[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8770]Asters Fruit Trees as Crops[/url] are installed.


[u]Joja Clearance Bin[/u]
Found in JojaMart
10% discount for members, but slightly higher prices than Pierre's for non-members (by 20%)
Up to five items for sale each day

Items include:
Food (Joja Cola, Pizza, Pepper Poppers, Cheese Broccoflower, or Smothered Garlic Potatoes)
Seeds (all seeds from all seasons excepting the coffee bean and rare seed, includes Joja Seeds)
Produce (may be regular, silver, or gold quality, includes Joja Seeds fruits and veggies)
Special seeds (from the oasis or Y2, rare)
Saplings (includes Asters Fruit Trees, uncommon)
Island seeds and saplings (only if island is unlocked, rare)


[u]Shane's Seeds and Eggs
[/u]Found inside the ranch
Prices vary with player's friendship with Shane, with a maximum discount if married
Store is open even if Shane or Marnie are not available
Up to five items for sale each day

Items include:
Seeds (all seeds from all seasons excepting the coffee bean and rare seed, includes Joja Seeds)
Eggs (may be regular, silver, gold, or iridium quality, and may be white, brown, or duck)
Other animal produce (feathers, wool, milk, may be regular or gold quality)
Special seeds (from the oasis or Y2, rare)
Saplings (includes Asters Fruit Trees, uncommon)
Island seeds and saplings (only if island is unlocked, rare)


Credit to Lemurkat, who requested that seeds be added to the blackmarket randomly out of season and wasn't too put out when I decided to make a whole other mod instead. :) After all, why would the blackmarket have old seeds?
